representativeExamples.note: Product-page calculator, read 2026-11-04 in the browser (defaults: 10,000,000 VND, 6 months): "Khoản thanh toán hàng tháng: 1,917,567 VNĐ". The page's script uses 4.16%/month (= 49.92%/year, the top of the new-customer range). The annuity formula at 4.16%/month for 6 months gives 1,917,567, so the figure is consistent. The total is not printed; 6 x 1,917,567 = 11,505,402 (our arithmetic). The page's own script (function pmt, rate/1200 per month, equal instalments) gives the same figure, so this is an equal-instalment annuity with monthly compounding. The contract instead accrues interest daily on a 365-day year, so a real schedule differs slightly. The calculator ignores fees and insurance and uses one fixed rate per product, not the borrower's own rate; the page says the result is only a reference ("chỉ mang tính chất tham khảo").

JACCS Vietnam app listing (developer JACCS INTERNATIONAL VIETNAM FINANCE COMPANY LIMITED; last updated 11 Sep 2026): 'VÍ DỤ MÔ PHỎNG KHOẢN VAY' 10,000,000 VND, 12 months, 'Lãi xuất tháng 2,39%', 'Lãi xuất năm 28,680%', 'Hình thức lãi: Theo dư nợ giảm dần', monthly 1,088,506, total (Gốc + Lãi) 13,145,506. FLAT/REDUCING TEST: 2.39% x 12 = 28.68, so the yearly figure is nominal (monthly x 12). Equal instalments at 2.39%/month on a reducing balance would be about 968,390 a month (11.62 million total); flat interest would be 1,072,333 a month (12.87 million total). The stated 1,088,506 fits neither label (it equals a reducing-balance annuity at about 52.4%/year, or the example includes charges the listing does not itemise). Also 12 x 1,088,506 = 13,062,072, which is 83,434 VND short of the stated total 13,145,506. So the example does not add up: do not use as a test fixture. The listing does not say which product it illustrates, and 28.68% is below the 30%/year new-customer minimum in the 04/11/2026 cash-loan table.

researchNotes: Researched 2026-11-04. LICENCE: 'Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV Quốc tế Việt Nam JACCS' (id jaccs-finance, licence 80/GP-NHNN of 25/7/2018) is on data/licensed-institutions.json and the legal name matches. LEAD CHECK (topi.vn, a comparison site, not copied): JACCS's own documents are per-product 'Bảng niêm yết lãi suất ... tại điểm giới thiệu dịch vụ' PDFs linked from each product page. Consumer loan: 'BẢNG NIÊM YẾT LÃI SUẤT CHO VAY TIÊU DÙNG CÁ NHÂN TẠI ĐIỂM GIỚI THIỆU DỊCH VỤ', Ngày cập nhật 04/11/2026, 26 rows from 11.3000% to 49.9200%/year, 'dư nợ giảm dần, 1 năm = 365 ngày'; it applies to the cash-loan product only, not the whole company. The 11.3% is for JIVF employees only (topi's '18-36 months' matches only that row; the table's terms overall run 3-36 months). Motorbike: 'BẢNG NIÊM YẾT LÃI SUẤT CHO VAY XE MÁY TẠI ĐIỂM GIỚI THIỆU DỊCH VỤ', Ngày cập nhật 01/08/2026, 0.0000% to 50.1266%, 6-36 months (matches topi). topi's 'average 21.84%/year' is not supported: JACCS's own monthly average-rate notices give 28.8029% (Oct 2026), 28.8323% (Sep), 29.7802% (Aug), 28.61% (Jul), 29.0064% (Jun), 30.3678% (May), 30.4655% (Apr), 30.1152% (Mar), 28.3218% (Jan) and 28.5898% (Dec 2025). COMPANY-WIDE FRAMEWORK: 'V/v: CÔNG BỐ KHUNG LÃI SUẤT THẢ NỔI (BAO GỒM LÃI SUẤT CƠ BẢN VÀ BIÊN ĐỘ)', posted 08/10/2026, effective 13/10/2026, covers 'các sản phẩm vay' (no product named): base rate 9.894%/year, adjusted every 3 months, plus a margin of 3.5% or 4.5%, giving 13.394% or 14.394%/year, reducing balance, 365 days. Stored on each product as regulatory_ceiling with an explicit company-wide segment, but it is NOT a cap: the contract template offers three rate forms (1 giai đoạn / nhiều giai đoạn / thả nổi), the floating one being 'lãi suất thả nổi được công bố ... sau các ngày 12/01, 12/04, 12/07 và 12/10', and every listed product rate (and JACCS's own 28.8% average) is far above 14.4%. Showing it as 'trần công bố' would mislead; 'benchmark' (base rate plus margin) is the closer meaning. The monthly average-rate notice (28.8029%, Oct 2026) is stored as a benchmark. OFFERED RANGES: only the cash loan is rankable (new customers 30-49.92%/year, from the table dated 04/11/2026, newer than every conflicting source). The three goods loans (motorbike, electronics, furniture) have a table range 0-50.1266% whose 0% is a promotion, and the JACCS Vietnam app listing (Google Play, updated 11/09/2026, newer than those tables) says personal loans are 0-36%, 6-84 months; they are excluded as conflicting_sources until JACCS says which applies. FLAT/REDUCING TESTS: the product-page calculators (cash 10M/6m = 1,917,567; motorbike 5M/6m = 907,880; electronics and furniture 3M/6m = 563,153, read in the browser) equal an equal-instalment annuity at annual rate/12 per month, matching the 'dư nợ giảm dần' label (monthly compounding, whereas the contract accrues daily on 365 days). The Google Play example (10M, 12m, 2.39%/month = 28.68%/year, 'dư nợ giảm dần', pays 1,088,506, total 13,145,506) fits neither reducing (968,390) nor flat (1,072,333), and 12 x 1,088,506 differs from the stated total by 83,434; it is marked internallyConsistent=false. The Honda Wave Alpha campaign states '0,39%/tháng (tính theo dư nợ ban đầu)', i.e. flat, a different basis from the tables. FEES: the only tariff found ('BIỂU PHÍ (ÁP DỤNG TỪ 01.08.2024)', at the end of 'Điều kiện giao dịch chung', page footer code V01-04.26) lists a 12,000 VND loan management fee (monthly or one-off for the term: ambiguous), free copies and SMS, and an early-settlement fee of 6% before/at the first instalment and 5% afterwards on outstanding principal (minimum 1,650,000 VND for cash and motorbike; 850,000 VND for electronics and furniture). Because the tariff states a 2024 effective date, its figures are capped at low. Early settlement option 1 requires paying all interest for the remaining term. A 6% breach compensation applies if the contract is terminated for the borrower's breach. INSURANCE: GTC art. 4 makes cover depend on the borrower agreeing; the consumer-loan contract template names 'Dư nợ tín dụng cá nhân' by Bảo hiểm AAA (premium blank, sum insured = initial loan, JIVF first beneficiary) and pre-prints 'Và mua bảo hiểm' as a loan purpose, with insurance lines inside the loan amount, but its appendix also says the borrower pays the premium. No premium figure is published anywhere we found. Car loans require vehicle insurance (out of scope). NOT FOUND (searched, not published): minimum/maximum age, minimum income and employer rules for any product (searched the product pages and calculators, FAQ, GTC, both contract templates, the Google Play listing, news posts of 04-10/2026, and a site:jaccs.com.vn search); a premium rate; an App Store listing (the website links only Google Play); a published worked example with amounts for the motorbike, electronics or furniture loans; whether the products are available in Hanoi and HCMC (the site mentions 34 provinces and cities). NOT RECORDED (out of scope or table mismatch): car, big motorbike (PKL), machinery, car parts, e-bicycle, electric motorbike and health/beauty loans. The website's electric-motorbike link (Published-Interest-Rate-EM_VN.pdf) actually serves a motorbike table dated 06/01/2026, and the car-parts and e-bicycle links look swapped (AS_VN and EB_VN). The 'JACCS Vietnam' app (developer JACCS INTERNATIONAL VIETNAM FINANCE COMPANY LIMITED) exists, but the product pages describe a counter-based process, so online is left null. JACCS also warns on its site of scammers impersonating JIVF. SURPRISES: the cash-loan rate table was updated on the same day as this research and may change; the tariff is dated 2024; no age rule or insurance premium is published; the contract-template address predates the 2025 ward reorganisation, so the template is probably old.
